clientForm.phone_hint: A number without a prefix is saved as a number from {country} ({prefix}). Enter a number from another country with a plus and its prefix.

import.title: Import clients from a file
import.intro: Move your clients over from a spreadsheet or notebook: upload a CSV file (Excel: Save as CSV) or paste a table. You'll see a preview and a list of problems first, and nothing is saved until you confirm. Clients don't get any invitations or messages.
import.format_hint: The first row holds the headers. We recognise the columns: First name, Last name (or Full name), Email, Phone, Dog, Breed. Separator: semicolon, comma or tab. Up to 500 clients at a time.
import.summary: Ready to import: {rows} of {total} rows, including {dogs, plural, one {# dog} other {# dogs}}.
import.truncated: The file has more than 500 rows: we import the first 500, load the rest in another file.
import.errors_title: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
import.warnings_title: {count, plural, one {# warning (row imported without one field)} other {# warnings (rows imported without one field)}}

issue.already_exists: this client is already in the school “{value}”

import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}
import.done: Done! Imported {clients, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}} and {dogs, plural, one {# dog} other {# dogs}}.
import.done_skipped: Skipped {count, plural, one {# client who was} other {# clients who were}} already in the school.
import.empty: Paste some data or choose a file.
import.too_large: The file is too large (1 MB limit). Split it into smaller ones.
import.no_name_column: No first name column found. Add a “First name” (or “Full name”) header in the first row.
import.nothing_to_import: Nothing to import: all rows were skipped.
